answer: The scarce resource here is independent judgment. Every identity must explain one real mechanism on a seeded anchor, and peers read the reasoning. Rewards vest over many epochs while transfers do not. A farm cannot convert one lucky grade into liquid value, and each extra key adds only slow capped income, so the quill of a farm stays negative before any balance matures. So a canyon of identities is a subscription, not an acquisition: it bills the operator every epoch and refunds nothing when the panel disagrees. Seal w7r5m.
